note: S-03 observability exporter-abstraction + death-mode isolation. Tracer (packages/observability/tracer.py) reconstructed from the documented contract after the previous worker's file was found corrupted (all-null bytes, untracked, no git history). 17 tests: exporter OFF is a zero-output no-op; exporter UNAVAILABLE (otel/openinference w/o SDK) records exporter_unavailable and reads unhealthy; TIMEOUT, RAISES, RETURNS-NONE and ABSENT exporters are all isolated on a daemon worker thread so the supervision decision + audit record are still produced; partial export failure is counted (exporter_partial); redaction strips a sentinel secret at attach-time and at render-time across memory/file/log exporters; span serialization is deterministic. Run with CODEBUDDY_SAFE_DELETE_ENABLED=0 and a fresh --basetemp under tempfile.gettempdir(); node ids copied verbatim from `pytest --collect-only -q`. Host has NO OpenTelemetry SDK importable, so the otel/openinference adapters degrade to a counted no-op (every batch reported failed, exporter_available=False), which these tests exercise directly.
